name: Baron 1898
description: A spectacular dive coaster themed around a 19th century gold mine, plunging 37.5 metres beyond vertical at 90 km/h with incredible theming and a haunting soundtrack.

name: Joris en de Draak
description: A world-class duelling wooden roller coaster where two trains race side by side through 1.1 kilometres of track at 75 km/h in a thrilling medieval dragon battle.

name: De Vliegende Hollander
description: A thrilling combination ride blending a roller coaster with a dramatic water finale based on the legend of the Flying Dutchman, ending in a spectacular splash.

name: Symbolica
description: An innovative dark ride palace adventure where guests ride in enchanted vehicles through the magical palace of King Pardulfus filled with stunning effects and surprises.

name: Droomvlucht
description: A gentle and dreamlike dark ride gliding through enchanted forests populated by fairies, elves and magical creatures in a timeless fairy tale world.

name: Fata Morgana
description: An exotic boat dark ride through the mysterious world of 1001 Nights featuring elaborate Arabian themed scenes, stunning animatronics and a magical atmosphere.

name: Python
description: A classic looping roller coaster with multiple inversions that has thrilled generations of park visitors since 1981, still delivering exciting G-forces.

name: Vogel Rok
description: A thrilling indoor roller coaster launched in complete darkness through an ancient Persian palace with a powerful soundtrack and exotic theming.

name: Aquanura
description: A spectacular water and fire show on the main lake performed multiple times daily, combining hundreds of water jets, fire effects and a magical musical score.

name: Sprookjesbos
description: The enchanted Fairy Tale Forest featuring iconic storybook scenes including Sleeping Beauty, Hansel and Gretel, Rapunzel and many more in magical walk-through settings.
